new_wheel.note: ⚠️ BOX-LOCAL (local 5900XT box, rustc 1.96.0). Two boxes compiling identical source produce different bytes — this value proves a REBUILD on THIS box, never cross-box agreement (carc_rs_build is the cross-box witness).

method: 20 seeded throwaway decks (9000000000xx — ⛔ no claimed band), whole games, k_dets=2 sims=64 tiearb_b=2 exact_endgame=off. Each arm was played under the PRE-change wheel (the venv's installed carc_rs) AND the POST-change wheel (built from this worktree, installed to a --target dir, ⛔ never over the main tree's wheel). Identity is asserted on the ACTION SEQUENCES and the final scores. The pre-change wheel cannot accept tiearb_phase_gate at all, so the two identity claims are CROSS-WHEEL by construction and cannot be produced inside one process.

claims.new.all == old.arb: gate=all IS today's ungated arbiter, bit for bit
claims.new.none == old.champ: gate=none IS the unmodified champion, bit for bit
claims.new.all == new.arb: within-wheel control (an explicit default is the default)
claims.old.champ == new.champ: the rebuild moved nothing off the arbiter surface
claims.new.early != new.all: POSITIVE CONTROL — the gate is not a no-op
